description: After human approval, freeze the reviewed SPEC/model/cases and translate every required law into an immutable public contract; establish independent harness and strict completeness checks before allowing implementation. Dependencies: human approval. Acceptance: missing laws, holes, and changes to spec/harness are rejected; gate imports the real public implementation.

Implement canonical AST validation, four-bit production evaluation and cost/size, without importing reference computation into the runtime path. Dependencies: 01. Acceptance: eval_refines and cost_refines kernel-check; exhaustive size<=3 evaluation agrees with independent Python integer semantics.

Implement a lazy finite grammar enumerator in exact node-count/lexicographic order for the permitted operator set. Dependencies: 02. Acceptance: enumeration theorem, size and operator membership, no duplicates, complete finite reference comparison, no full-space materialization before the first bounded attempt.

Implement total equivalence certification, actual production-evaluator bridge, strict-improvement portable certificates and independent replay. Dependencies: 02. Acceptance: certification_sound/complete, replay_sound/roundtrip; every unequal program produces a real counterexample; mutations to output table, reference, candidate and cost are rejected.

Implement start/advance/synthesize and ranked best over the actual visited prefix. Dependencies: 03,04. Acceptance: start_valid, advance_exact, budget_conserved, resume_composes, best_prefix, status_exact; zero allowance and chunked histories agree with independent enumeration; all attempts including failures are charged; no top-up or serialized state import.

Implement eval/synthesize/replay JSON interfaces in Bend, validation, canonical output and exit codes. Dependencies: 02,04,05. Acceptance: actual native executable passes cases.json, malformed and duplicate-key inputs rejected, proof coverage of parsing/encoding explicitly separated from pure-core proofs.

Exercise independent exhaustive Python evaluator/search oracle and all listed semantic mutations. Dependencies: 01 through 06. Acceptance: exact coverage counts, all 16 inputs per expression, prefix ranking and resume checks, each defect fails the intended invariant; no Python or FFI in production path.

Run the complete frozen gate from a clean checkout, publish hashes and raw logs, user commands and trust boundaries. Dependencies: 07. Acceptance: all named laws kernel-check, native CLI and negative tests pass, no claim of global optimality outside exhausted grammar or hardware speed from abstract cost.
